title: API tokens
subtitle: For the iPhone Shortcut (send text or a photo to the app) and the read-only summary.
label: Name
shown: Copy this token now. It will not be shown again.
shortcutSteps: Create an INGEST token above and copy it.
Open the Shortcuts app and create a new shortcut. In its details, turn on Show in Share Sheet and accept Text, Images and PDF.
Add the action Get Contents of URL. URL: {url}/api/v1/ingest. Method: POST.
Under Headers add Authorization with the value Bearer followed by a space and your token.
Request Body: Form. Add a field named text with the Shortcut Input for text, or a File field named file for images and PDF.
Share anything to the shortcut. It arrives in Record under Waiting for review; nothing is saved until you confirm.
summaryBody: GET {url}/api/v1/summary with a SUMMARY_READ token returns safe to spend today, left in the period, days left and net worth.
pushBody: On iPhone, push notifications only work after you add the app to the Home Screen (Share, Add to Home Screen) and open it from there.
